text: EXECUTIVE TEAM The Switch Executive team is comprised of passionate, dedicated industry experts, bringing decades of experience to a leading technology infrastructure company. Switch’s founder and CEO, Rob Roy, cultivates a unique client-oriented culture at every level of the company. The team’s motivation and drive to produce the absolute best results for our clients manifests in unparalleled client value and the industry’s best customer service. Rob Roy FOUNDER & CEO Rob Roy is widely recognized as the inventor of many critical data center innovations that have become industry standards. His patented designs for cooling, power distribution, software, networking and physical security have enabled data centers to scale to densities and efficiencies that were previously thought impossible. Since founding the company in 2000, he has led Switch as founder, CEO, designer and inventor — engineering digital infrastructure as an integrated system long before the industry recognized its importance. Combining business leadership, engineering precision, commercial strategy, and advanced technology vision, Mr. Roy has designed some of the largest and most advanced technology ecosystems ever built. His breakthroughs in the data center industry first materialized as a modular design in 2005 and the world’s first gigawatt scale campus in 2015. These Switch campus ecosystems are currently growing to multiple gigawatt scale locations across the United States. These original industry leading extreme density designs have now evolved into the world’s most powerful Cloud/AI Factories — hybrid air- and liquid-cooled environments purpose-built for accelerated computing and engineered to scale with Cloud and AI’s multi-generational roadmaps. Decades before artificial intelligence reshaped global infrastructure demand, Rob Roy anticipated the need for AI-native environments. Today, his vision powers the foundation of the Cloud/AI economy — positioning Switch as a leading owner, developer, and operator of digital exascale data center ecosystems. Jason Hoffman CHIEF STRATEGY OFFICER Jason Hoffman is the Chief Strategy Officer at Switch. Jason is a thought and execution leader in the industrialization trend for datacenters where he pioneered hardware and software designs that could drive wholesale supply chain efficiencies while making these systems highly accessible and usable to developers. There are variations of this called “cloud computing”, “edge computing”, “industrial internet” etc. Jason also serves as the Executive-in-Residence at Automattic, Inc and a Managing Partner at S8 Advisory Partners, a board, shareholder and corporate development advisory firm. Previously, Jason was the Executive-in-Residence at Counterpoint Global in Morgan Stanley (a public equities growth investor), the founding CEO of MobiledgeX, Inc., an edge computing company acquired by Google in 2022; a CTO and Product Area head at Ericsson AB in Sweden where he led the industry’s virtualization of mobile networks, and the founder and CTO at Joyent, a cloud computing company acquired and still operated by Samsung. He was also the founding Chair of the Board at NPM, Inc. (acquired by GitHub) and Incredible Labs (acquired by Yahoo) and an outside Board Member at the Wordpress Foundation and an Advisor at Automattic, Inc. Prior to his work in computer science, Jason was a fellow at the Novartis Institute for Functional Genomics, obtained his PhD at the Burnham Institute (now “Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute”) with Erkki Ruoslahti, MD PhD, and earned a BS/MS in Biochemistry from University of California, Los Angeles. Broadly speaking, he studies adaptive complex systems that result in disease and his predominant scientific areas of interests are in Cancer, Infectious Diseases and Aging, and interdisciplinary areas: Systems Biology, Synthetic Biology and Combinatorial Methods. His hobbies are Strength and Conditioning for Olympic Combat Sports. He’s a member of the American College of Sports Medicine, the National Strength and Conditioning Association (NSCA), a Lifetime Member of USA Judo/USJF and a certified coach with USA Wrestling and USA Fencing. Chris Donnelly CHIEF CONNECTIVITY OFFICER Chris Donnelly is the CXO (Chief Connectivity Officer) at Switch. Since joining Switch in 2008, Chris has focused his efforts on the development of digital services platforms and the one-of-a-kind exascale telecom purchasing co-op known as The CORE Cooperative. This unique and powerful entity aggregates the collective buying power of Switch clients to create the single largest telecommunications purchasing cooperative in the marketplace. The combined market capitalization of The CORE Cooperative users has a cumulative market cap of over seven trillion dollars. Chris works closely with the company’s global carrier partners to ensure the Switch data centers and exascale data center campuses are among the most cost-effective and network-enabled facilities in the world. The company’s unique fiber optic gateways are among the most robust network access points (NAP) in North America. Prior to joining Switch, Chris has over 30 years of experience in the telecom industry and held various executive positions in the combined companies of Verizon (MFS, UUNET, WorldCom, MCI) as well as Qwest Communications. Chris also served as the President of Splice Communications, Inc. from 2003 until 2007. Jesse Burros CHIEF INVESTMENT OFFICER Jesse Burros is the Chief Investment Officer at Switch. He is a member of the executive leadership team and plays a key role in Switch’s capital allocation and capital formation. In addition to shaping Switch’s long-term investment strategy, he partners across the organization to align capital deployment with Switch’s growth and return objectives.
